description: Foxtail grasses, named for the dense cylindrical seedheads. The common name covers several species.
nativeStatus: Some Setaria are native and others introduced; verify the exact species
ecology: Native grasses are the backbone of this landscape. They feed seed-eating birds, supply nesting material and shelter ground-dwelling insects.
wildlifeNotes: The seedheads feed finches, sparrows and other granivorous birds, and the clumps shelter ground-dwelling insects.
flowering: Spike-like seedheads in the warm season
